in_hebrew.name: גליט
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Gillette is derived from the Hebrew word 'gil' meaning 'young goat'. It may also be associated with the Hebrew word 'gillet' meaning 'slayer'. The name Gillette can be interpreted as 'young goat slayer'.

in_greek.name: Γιλλέττη
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Gillette in Greek origin is Γιλλέττη, derived from the Greek words 'ghello' meaning 'shining, glistening' and 'tes' meaning 'the'. The name Gillette can be interpreted as 'the shining one' or 'the glistening one'.

in_latin.name: Gillette
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Gillette in Latin origin is derived from the Latin word 'gilletus', meaning 'little goat'. It may also be associated with the Latin word 'gallus' meaning 'rooster'.
